## 問題
黑貓宅急便 2025 年第一季的準時送達率是多少？

## 回答 A
最終答案: 無法判定
採用的定義與依據: shipments 表只有 shipped_ts 與 delivered_ts，沒有預計送達日；語意層也查無「準時送達」或配送時效（SLA）的定義，無法判斷哪些出貨單算準時。2025 年第一季黑貓共 4,979 筆出貨，其中 528 筆沒有送達時間，實際平均運送天數為 2.46 天，但這些數字不足以推算準時率，需補充承運商的預計送達時效後才能計算。
SQL 1: ["SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS n FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY n DESC", "SELECT * FROM shipments LIMIT 5"]
  結果: [{'query': 'SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS n FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY n DESC', 'columns': ['carrier', 'n'], 'rows': [['blackcat', 19911], ['hct', 11092], ['sf', 6806], ['post', 6635]], 'truncated': False}, {'query': 'SELECT * FROM shipments LIMIT 5', 'columns': ['shipment_id', 'order_id
SQL 2: ["SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts IS NULL OR delivered_ts = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_delivery, MIN(shipped_ts) AS min_ship, MAX(shipped_ts) AS max_ship FROM shipments WHERE carrier = 'blackcat' AND shipped_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-04-01'", "SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_days, MIN(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)) AS min_days, MAX(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)) AS max_days FROM shipments WHERE carrier = 'blackcat' AND shipped_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-04-01' AND delivered_ts IS NOT NULL"]
  結果: [{'query': "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts IS NULL OR delivered_ts = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_delivery, MIN(shipped_ts) AS min_ship, MAX(shipped_ts) AS max_ship FROM shipments WHERE carrier = 'blackcat' AND shipped_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-04-01'", 'columns'

## 回答 B
最終答案: 67.13
採用的定義與依據: 依語意層定義，準時送達率 = 配送天數（送達−出貨，含小數）≤ 3 天的出貨筆數 ÷ 已送達出貨筆數，分母只含已送達紀錄，期間依訂單成立時間歸屬。篩選 shipments.carrier = 'blackcat'（黑貓宅急便）且 orders.order_ts 落在 2025-01-01 至 2025-03-31，得到 3015 / 4491 = 67.13%，且無送達早於出貨的異常資料。
SQL 1: ["SELECT s.shipment_id, s.carrier, s.shipped_ts, s.delivered_ts, o.order_ts, o.status FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE s.carrier = 'blackcat' LIMIT 10", "SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS undelivered FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier"]
  結果: [{'query': "SELECT s.shipment_id, s.carrier, s.shipped_ts, s.delivered_ts, o.order_ts, o.status FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE s.carrier = 'blackcat' LIMIT 10", 'columns': ['shipment_id', 'carrier', 'shipped_ts', 'delivered_ts', 'order_ts', 'status'], 'rows': [[2, 'b
SQL 2: SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_n, SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(s.delivered_ts) - julianday(s.shipped_ts) <= 3.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time_n, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(s.delivered_ts) - julianday(s.shipped_ts) <= 3.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS on_time_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(s.delivered_ts) < julianday(s.shipped_ts) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_days_n, MIN(o.order_ts) AS min_order_ts, MAX(o.order_ts) AS max_order_ts FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE s.carrier = 'blackcat' AND s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND o.order_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts < '2025-04-01'
  結果: {'columns': ['delivered_n', 'on_time_n', 'on_time_rate', 'negative_days_n', 'min_order_ts', 'max_order_ts'], 'rows': [[4491, 3015, 67.13, 0, '2025-01-01 00:44:10', '2025-03-31 23:35:26']], 'truncated': False}

response: {"winner": "B", "reason": "B 依明確定義（送達−出貨 ≤ 3 天 ÷ 已送達筆數，期間依訂單成立時間歸屬）寫出與定義一致的 SQL，得出 3015/4491 = 67.13%，並檢查了負天數異常；A 只稱查無準時定義而回答「無法判定」，沒有回答問題。不過兩者對語意層是否有此定義說法相反，我無法驗證；若定義確實不存在，A 的處理才合理。", "critical_error": "A"}
